assessments.reasoning: Section 6.1.1700 gives both the compile-time control-flow stack effect and the consuming run-time data stack effect. The run-time rule transfers execution to the resolved reference only for an all-zero-bit value. Interpretation semantics are undefined.

challenge.method: Compared the C: stack and run-time notation and checked §3.2.3.2 on the abstract control-flow stack and the entry's THEN/ELSE examples.
challenge.results: The forward reference is a compile-time location, and the run-time input is a consumed stack item. The control-flow stack need not physically exist as a separate implementation stack.

limitations: The entry leaves interpretation semantics undefined and gives THEN and ELSE as examples of resolving the reference.
